title: How to Visit Turkmenistan: Visa, LOI & Entry Guide
intro: For tourist travel to Turkmenistan, official embassy guidance describes a two-stage process: first obtain a Letter of Invitation (LOI) through a Turkmenistan travel agency, with approval from the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan; then obtain the visa sticker through a Turkmenistan embassy or consulate, or at an eligible border crossing with a valid LOI.

overview.title: Do Tourists Need a Visa and Letter of Invitation for Turkmenistan?
paragraphs: For a Turkmenistan tourist visa, official Turkmenistan embassy guidance says travelers should work with a travel agency to obtain a Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan. The LOI is the document that supports permission to enter and forms the basis for the tourist visa.

After the LOI is approved, the visa sticker can be obtained through a Turkmenistan embassy or consulate abroad. Current official embassy guidance also states that, with a valid LOI, the visa sticker may be issued on arrival at Turkmenistan border crossing points, including international airports.

Because the invitation is tied to the traveler, dates and travel arrangements, it is best to confirm the basic route before starting the visa process. Travelers should still check the Turkmenistan embassy or consular guidance relevant to their nationality and place of application before departure.

quote: For a tourist trip to Turkmenistan, think of the process in two parts: LOI approval first, then the visa sticker. Your route, dates and entry point should be planned before the paperwork is finalized.

guide_sections.title: Letter of Invitation for Turkmenistan
paragraphs: The Letter of Invitation, usually called the LOI, is the key document for a Turkmenistan tourist visa. Official Turkmenistan embassy guidance states that the tourist LOI application is submitted by a Turkmenistan national travel agency to the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan.

The LOI should be prepared around the traveler’s passport details, intended dates and travel program. Approval is an official process, so travelers should avoid building a tight multi-country schedule until the Turkmenistan portion has been properly planned.

The Turkmenistan Embassy in Washington states that an invitation certified by the State Migration Service is valid for three months from the date of certification. Travelers should nevertheless follow the validity dates shown on their own approved documentation.

guide_sections.title: How the Turkmenistan Tourist Visa Is Issued
paragraphs: Official Turkmenistan embassy guidance describes visa issuance as the second stage after the LOI. Once permission to enter has been granted through the LOI, the traveler obtains a visa sticker in the passport.

The visa sticker can be obtained at a Turkmenistan embassy or consulate abroad. Current official embassy guidance also states that a traveler with the required valid LOI can obtain the visa sticker on arrival at Turkmenistan border crossing points, including international airports.
The exact application documents, fees and processing arrangements depend on where the visa is issued. Check the relevant Turkmenistan embassy, consulate or official migration guidance before travel.

guide_sections.title: What Documents Are Commonly Required?
paragraphs: The exact document list depends on the embassy or point of visa issuance, but official Turkmenistan embassy guidance commonly lists a valid passport, passport copy, visa application form, photograph and the approved Letter of Invitation.

Several Turkmenistan embassy pages state that the passport should remain valid for at least six months from the date of departure. Travelers should check the requirements of the embassy or consulate handling their own application because submission methods and supporting documents can differ.

guide_sections.title: Airport and Land Border Entry Planning
paragraphs: Turkmenistan itineraries can begin at Ashgabat International Airport or at land-border crossings used for regional journeys. For Uzbekistan combinations, routes may connect through border points serving Khiva/Dashoguz or Bukhara/Turkmenabat, depending on the confirmed itinerary.

Official Turkmenistan embassy guidance states that visa stickers may be issued on arrival at border crossing points, including international airports, once the required LOI has been obtained. Your tour, transfer and border arrangements should match the entry and exit points shown in the confirmed travel plan.

guide_sections.title: What Official Turkmenistan Embassy Guidance Says
paragraphs: Turkmenistan embassy guidance published in Vienna and Abu Dhabi describes the visa process in two stages: permission to enter through an LOI issued by the State Migration Service, followed by the visa sticker in the passport.

The same official guidance states that for a tourist visa, the LOI application is handled by a Turkmenistan national travel agency. The visa sticker may then be obtained through a Turkmenistan diplomatic mission abroad or, with the required LOI, on arrival at a border crossing point.

Official requirements can be updated, and individual embassies may have different submission procedures. Before departure, travelers should confirm the current rules with the Turkmenistan embassy or consulate responsible for their place of application and with their tour organizer.

guide_sections.title: How Route Planning Affects the Visa Process
paragraphs: A tourist itinerary should be planned before the LOI process because the trip dates, entry point, exit point and local travel arrangements need to work together. Short routes often combine Ashgabat and Darvaza, while longer journeys add Mary, Ancient Merv, Old Nisa, Gokdepe or cross-border connections.

For travelers combining Turkmenistan with Uzbekistan or a Five Stans journey, the Turkmenistan segment should be positioned carefully in the overall itinerary. Border direction, domestic transport and the approved travel dates can affect the rest of the multi-country route.

items.title: Start With Your Route
items.text: Before the LOI application begins, confirm your approximate travel dates, entry point, exit point and the main places you want to visit.

items.title: Allow Time for Official Approval
items.text: The LOI is subject to official processing by the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan, so avoid leaving the process until the last minute.

items.title: Check the Correct Embassy Procedure
items.text: Application forms, submission methods, fees and processing arrangements can differ between Turkmenistan embassies and consulates.

items.title: Carry Your LOI and Passport Documents
items.text: Keep the approved LOI and required passport/visa documents accessible when traveling to the airport or land border.

items.title: Reconfirm Before Departure
items.text: Visa and entry rules can change. Recheck current official Turkmenistan consular or migration guidance shortly before travel.
